core_claim: A staged single-cell workflow can connect sample processing to interpretable cell-state, marker, and composition summaries.
audience: Researchers evaluating a double-column manuscript figure demonstration

selection.chosen_type: method-to-evidence multi-panel: staged workflow + embedding + heatmap + normalized stacked bars
selection.reason: Historical demonstration generated after the user delegated the test composition to the skill.

evidence.source: workflow labels authored for this demonstration

comparison: Illustrative control-versus-treatment composition; no inferential claim or statistical test.
uncertainty: Six simulated donors per group; no confidence intervals because the panel demonstrates composition layout only.

panels.claim: The reading order from sample to interpretation is explicit.
Simulated cells form five visually distinct illustrative states.
Illustrative lineage markers distinguish the simulated states.
Synthetic donor-level composition can be compared without implying significance.

reading_order: A workflow, then B embedding, C marker validation, and D donor-level composition.
integrity_risks: All values are synthetic and must not be interpreted as experimental evidence.
Embedding distance is illustrative and is not a calibrated biological distance.
No statistical significance is implied by the composition panel.
provenance: Style precedent: PubCNS case 96 (Nature Nanotechnology); no artwork traced or copied.
